_note: Two steps, not three. The opener is `world.final_stretch_press`, and it is NOT a step: a card cannot be both the thing that starts an arc and a step that arc gates — §10.10 excludes steps from the pool, so such a card can never fire at all.
_revision_2026_09: invalidate_when no longer fades the arc on phase.series_a_signal == open. An OPEN signal is not a closed round: the 08-27 hole fix let the opener fire in phase 2 with the gate open and this arc then faded the same day, so the comment and Frank's verdict never came; in phase 3 the signal is always open and a Hunt without a live offer reached day 730 unwarned. Only a SIGNED Series A ends the warning.
